acceptanceChecks: Never replace or delete originals, old posts, or existing cached media
Generate a 480px or 320px JPEG <=125 KiB within owner Storage namespace before confirming tagged original upload

If preview lookup/download/display fails, Android falls back to original with bounded no-infinite-loading behavior
Full photo viewer and photo editing use original, not sidecar
No schema migration, paid transformation, public media URL, native dependency, APK, or web behavior change
Engineering Accountability, TypeScript/Performance and Integration QA required before exact-source production Android OTA
